tap.prompt: A single soft, friendly UI button pop for a children's game. Short, round, wooden-toy quality. No music.

countdown.prompt: A single short arcade race countdown beep, mid pitch, clean and bright. One beep only.

go.prompt: A single bright, cheerful arcade race start signal: one long high beep with a happy sparkle. Children's kart racing game.

pickup.prompt: A magical sparkly item pickup in a children's kart racing game: an egg cracking open into a quick twinkling roulette of chimes.

gotItem.prompt: A short, cheerful two-note reward ding on a xylophone. Children's game. Bright and clean.

drop.prompt: A cartoon bone being dropped on a road: one short hollow wooden clatter with a comedic bounce.

boost.prompt: A cartoon speed boost for a go-kart: a quick rising whoosh with a playful rocket burst. Children's game, not harsh.

throwEgg.prompt: A cartoon throw: a quick springy whoosh as a big egg is launched forwards and rolls away. Children's game.

hit.prompt: A cartoon go-kart spin-out: a short comedic tyre skid with a wobbly boing. Funny, gentle, not scary. Children's game.

lap.prompt: A very short, bright three-note fanfare jingle for completing a lap in a children's kart racing game. Xylophone and bell.

finish.prompt: A cheerful victory fanfare for finishing a race in a children's kart racing game: bouncy brass and xylophone with a little cheer at the end.

engine.prompt: A small toy go-kart engine running at a steady speed: a soft, friendly, constant putt-putt motor hum. Even and continuous with no revving, no gear changes, no music.

tar.prompt: A thick gloopy splat: a blob of sticky tar dropping onto a road. Short, wet, cartoonish. Children's game.

stuck.prompt: A cartoon go-kart driving into sticky goo: a short squelchy, slurpy slow-down sound with a comedic gloop. Children's game, not gross.

ptero.prompt: A friendly cartoon pterodactyl: one cheerful squawk followed by big leathery wing flaps swooping upward. Children's game, not scary.

splash.prompt: A big, happy cartoon splash: a go-kart landing in shallow water at the bottom of a waterfall. Bright, bubbly and fun, with a short spray of droplets after. Children's game.

surfaceRoad.prompt: Seamless loop: small rubber go-kart tyres rolling steadily over a dry dirt and fine gravel track. Soft, even, continuous crunchy rolling texture. No engine, no skids, no bumps, no music.

surfaceWater.prompt: Seamless loop: a small go-kart driving steadily through shallow water. Continuous gentle sloshing, splashing and spray, bright and playful. No engine, no big splashes, no music.

surfaceBridge.prompt: Seamless loop: small wheels rolling quickly across the planks of a wooden bridge. A steady, hollow, rhythmic wooden rumble and clatter. No engine, no creaking, no music.

surfaceGrass.prompt: Seamless loop: a small go-kart driving through long grass and leafy plants. Continuous soft swishing and rustling. No engine, no music.
